people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Ahithophel
people.line: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide

people.name: Hushai
people.line: David's friend and advisor who helped him during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: When Hushai had come to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, “Ahithophel has spoken like this. Shall we do what he says? If not, speak up.”
translations.bsb: So Hushai came to Absalom, who told him, “Ahithophel has spoken this proposal. Should we carry it out? If not, what do you say?”
translations.kjv: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak thou.
translations.asv: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not, speak thou.
